svg.title: Checkout compliance, chargeback & piracy defense tree
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-05-piracy-refund-triage-tree; chart type: decision_tree; title: Checkout compliance, chargeback & piracy defense tree; subtitle: Operational triage before scaling paid traffic; chapter number: 5; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Numbers identify decision nodes; keep dispute ratio well below the 0.75% card-network threshold.; caption: Prevent friendly-fraud chargebacks and group-buy leaks structurally through MoR tax handling, CE 3.0 logs, 1-click refunds, and fingerprinted files.; stages: label: Global tax covered?; value: Node 1; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Yes via MoR or registered tax engine: advance to Node 2. No: route international/nexus checkout to MoR.; label: CE 3.0 telemetry?; value: Node 2; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Log IP, device, timestamp, license activation, and download events to win friendly-fraud representments.; label: Dispute rate <0.4%?; value: Node 3; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Yes: scale traffic. Elevated: enable self-serve 1-click refunds/cancellations so unhappy buyers refund instead of disputing.; label: Canary watermark?; value: Node 4; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Embed buyer-specific canary hashes and automate 17 U.S.C. 512(c) DMCA notices on leaked repos.
